chunks: He said: And the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Whoever does not bless me when I am mentioned in his presence will enter the Fire; Allah, Mighty and Majestic, will have detached him from His mercy.

key_terms.رَحْمَة: Divine mercy; the most comprehensive attribute of Allah's grace toward creation
key_terms.عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic — honorific title for Allah frequently used in hadith literature
key_terms.يُصَلِّ عَلَيَّ: Sending blessings/salawat upon the Prophet; a highly recommended act in Islamic tradition

ai.seo_question: What happens to someone who does not send blessings on the Prophet when his name is mentioned?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) warned that neglecting to invoke blessings upon him when his name is mentioned is a grave sin that distances a person from divine mercy and leads to the Fire. This hadith, reported in the context of the assembly of Shaykh al-Saduq, reflects the widespread Shia and Sunni tradition of sending salawat (blessings) upon the Prophet whenever his name is heard or uttered. The original audience would have understood this as a binding religious duty, with the invocation of divine anger serving as a stern admonition.
word_analysis: then He will have distanced him
